summary: Discusses requirements and design considerations for addressing maintenance points (MIPs) on incoming and outgoing interfaces of nodes in MPLS-TP OAM, including restrictions on how OAM messages must be formed so they reach the right MIP through the forwarding engine. The aim is to make sure OAM messages can be forwarded correctly to the intended point.

eli5.summary: When checking a building, you must name which door you want to inspect. This explains how to name each door.
